veranderings.voor: Baie van die potte en die messe en die vurke
veranderings.na: Baie van die potte, messe en vurke
veranderings.rede: A list joined by repeated 'en die' reads wooden; commas and one 'en' are natural.

veranderings.voor: eienskappe wat saamwerk en dit is hoekom
veranderings.na: eienskappe wat saamwerk, en dit is hoekom
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two sentences with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Glas blink ook en 'n nat klip
veranderings.na: Glas blink ook, en 'n nat klip
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two sentences with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Jy ken metaal uit aan al hierdie eienskappe saam.
veranderings.na: Jy ken metaal aan al hierdie eienskappe saam uit.
veranderings.rede: The particle of the separable verb 'uitken' naturally stands at the end, as in the glossary sentence.

veranderings.blok: Blink hoort by 'n skoon en gladde stuk metaal
veranderings.voor: 'n Splinternuwe munt blink en jy sien
veranderings.na: 'n Splinternuwe munt blink, en jy sien
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two sentences with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Blink hoort by 'n skoon en gladde stuk metaal
veranderings.voor: jare lank rond en sy buitekant
veranderings.na: jare lank rond, en sy buitekant
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two sentences with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Blink hoort by 'n skoon en gladde stuk metaal
veranderings.voor: nog altyd van metaal en net sy buitekant
veranderings.na: nog steeds van metaal, en net sy buitekant
veranderings.rede: 'nog steeds' says 'still' unambiguously ('nog altyd' can read as 'always has been'), plus the AWS comma between two sentences.

veranderings.voor: Die meeste metale is hard en daarom
veranderings.na: Die meeste metale is hard, en daarom
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two sentences with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Nie elke metaal is ewe hard nie en party
veranderings.na: Nie alle metale is ewe hard nie, en party
veranderings.rede: 'Nie alle metale ... nie' is the natural form and agrees with the plural 'party'; plus the AWS comma between two sentences.

veranderings.blok: Sterk wanneer jy trek of druk
veranderings.rede: 'aanmekaar' already says joined; 'vas' after it is redundant.

veranderings.blok: Sterk wanneer jy trek of druk
veranderings.voor: Die meeste metale is sterk en daarom
veranderings.na: Die meeste metale is sterk, en daarom
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two sentences with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Sterk wanneer jy trek of druk
veranderings.voor: Sterk gaan oor die hele stuk wat breek of heel bly.
veranderings.na: Sterk gaan oor of die hele stuk breek of heel bly.
veranderings.rede: The relative clause reads as 'the whole piece that breaks'; 'of ... breek of heel bly' states the question the property is about.

veranderings.blok: Metaal kan in dun drade getrek word
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two sentences with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Metaal kan in dun drade getrek word
veranderings.voor: dunner en langer en dit breek nie
veranderings.na: dunner en langer, en dit breek nie
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before the 'en' that starts a new sentence; none inside 'dunner en langer'.

veranderings.voor: bly net so hard en hy word
veranderings.na: bly net so hard, en hy word
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two sentences with their own subject and verb.
'klaar potte' is colloquial; 'klaargemaakte potte' is the standard adjective form.

veranderings.voor: uit die grond en daardie klip
veranderings.na: uit die grond, en daardie klip
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two sentences with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Uit daardie klip haal hulle die metaal self uit.
veranderings.na: Daarna haal hulle die metaal self uit daardie klip.
veranderings.rede: The double 'uit ... uit' is clumsy; the plain order reads more easily and 'daarna' only makes the existing sequence explicit.

veranderings.voor: wanneer hulle sê metaal word gemyn
veranderings.na: wanneer hulle sê dat metaal gemyn word
veranderings.rede: Reported speech with 'dat' and verb-final order is clearer and more standard.

vlae.teks: Die water hou die pot 'n bietjie warmer as die kookwater self.
vlae.rede: Read alone, this says the water makes the pot warmer; the point seems to be that the water keeps the pot from getting much hotter than boiling water (perhaps 'net 'n bietjie'). Fixing it means guessing the intended claim, so it is left to the writer.

vlae.blok: Metaal kan in dun drade getrek word
vlae.teks: Elke keer word die koper dunner en langer en dit breek nie.
vlae.rede: 'Elke keer' implies repeated pulling, but the sentence before mentions only one pull through one hole; the repetition is not stated, so a change would add content.

vlae.teks: Baie potte begin hulle lewe as 'n plat stuk metaal sonder enige vorm.
vlae.rede: A flat piece does have a shape, so 'sonder enige vorm' is loose; possibly meant 'nog sonder 'n pot se vorm'. Left unchanged because it touches meaning.

vlae.teks: Jy ken metaal uit aan al hierdie eienskappe saam.
vlae.rede: 'hierdie eienskappe' points forward to properties not yet named in this block; it works as an introduction, but the referent is vague for a reader of the opening block.
